publisher: Greater London Authority / Old Oak and Park Royal Development Corporation
authority: Old Oak and Park Royal Development Corporation (OPDC)
evidence_slice: OPDC's Local Plan was adopted on 22 June 2022. The official OPDC Local Plan Policies Map dataset describes the Site Allocations layer as 42 sites used to demonstrate land supply and the National Data Library records the dataset as updated 30 July 2026. The authority's Site Allocations FeatureServer layer 25 is an esriGeometryPolygon layer in British National Grid EPSG:27700 supporting JSON, GeoJSON and PBF. Official OPDC strategic-site evidence identifies Site Allocation 26 as Channel Gate, 9.98 hectares, residential mixed use with retention of the bus depot, with plan-period capacity of 3,100 homes and 10,729 square metres of economic floorspace.

field_evidence.allocation: Residential mixed use with retention of bus depot

binding_method: adopted strategic site allocation plus current official downloadable geospatial dataset and dedicated polygon FeatureServer layer; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: The current official dataset and GIS service were accessed through public web transport, but raw GPKG/feature-query bytes were not acquired; no source-file or polygon hash is fabricated.
license: No licence is stated on the National Data Library dataset page; the dataset notes that boundaries are based on Ordnance Survey mapping and published under Ordnance Survey's presumption to publish.
